description: Complete 7-function retro arcade snake engine. Decompiled binary separates snake body coordinate ring buffers (0x00404000, 0x00404080) and direction vector tables (0x00404100) from the physics step loop. Multi-agent swarm reconstructs the entire game engine into playable C.
